evidence: The frozen seed at task/environment/assets/seed_data.json:1-4 consists only of snippets=[] and the plain note "The saved library starts empty. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history." It has no records, IDs, foreign-key references, people, organisations, personal data, credentials, URLs, code or grading directives; the product note is ordinary scope information, not an injection payload. A fresh Python JSON parse with duplicate-key detection passed the seed and the three project JSON manifests/configuration files; no project CSV/TSV fixture exists. Seed SHA256 verified from current bytes: f9f2ee2643477f3946c4f79d00b19e6c9e42e2659a465f279d70f5f8f92cd808. The empty collection agrees with task/environment/instructions/integration.md:11 and tests/app_context.md:8. Golden server.js:147-168 creates empty snippet/history/restore tables and derives any migrated history only from existing snippet rows; app.tsx:20-26 starts with empty source, library and history. Adversarial reasoning: a permanently empty dead library can satisfy seed cleanliness alone, but constraints/judge.toml:25-27 requires a newly authored save and clean-context retrieval, so empty seed data does not pre-satisfy persistence proof. A conforming implementation with an empty initial editor/library is expressly accepted (app_context.md:8), and later dimensions are told to preserve the gate-created record rather than demand a pristine seed (line 24). This is static data/parse evidence for row 14, not configured-judge or portal execution evidence.
